title: Eng (Tier-1 CI): macro-valuation-backfill.yml declares a research_unit input and lands an E5 research/results record via .github/actions/research-result, so RQ-20260928-010 (M28 realistic-cost rescore) can run as an accruing queue unit
note: [2026-10-14 lane P4-MACRO-PROGRAMME] Found by grading RQ-20260928-010 with scripts/research/research_queue.grade_power: state unverifiable -- an accruing unit must declare run.inputs.research_unit, and the workflow declares none (adding it to the unit alone = HTTP 422). The unit's cost proxy (fee_frac 0.005, carry 0.0) and inputs are otherwise decided. Done when: unit git mv'd back to research/queue/ with research_unit in run.inputs and dispatch_queue.py dry-run grades it would_dispatch. Programme: docs/research/programmes/04-MACRO-SLEEVE.md Q1. [2026-10-16 lane P4-MACRO-BACKLOG-1016] CHEAPER PATH than editing the workflow: a thin scripts/research/macro_valuation_rescore.py that imports scripts/macro/{fetch_macro_candles,thesis_backtest_run} in-process (scripts/research/macro_event_study_run.py already imports fetch_macro_candles this way; script_run.py's allowlist checks only argv[0] and that the script is under scripts/research/), runs the rescore at --fee-frac/--carry-frac-per-day against the committed comms/macro/valuation_snapshots_backfill.jsonl, and writes verdict.json -- research-script-run.yml then lands the E5 record itself, no workflow input needed. Either path closes this row. Consumers: blocked/RQ-20260928-010 (Q1), then programme nodes P4-Q1-cost-read (valuation-read calibration, per-symbol cut) and P4-Q1-options-cost in research/programmes/04-macro-sleeve.yaml. [2026-10-16 lane P4-MACRO-BACKLOG-1016] VERIFIED in src/units/strategies/macro_thesis/thesis_backtest.py: net_return = raw - |fee_frac| - |carry_frac| (carry = per-day x a fixed 30-day hold), i.e. a CONSTANT per entry, and the all-long baseline arm pays the same cost on the same entries. So at fee_frac 0.005 calibration_rank (a Spearman rank, shift-invariant) cannot move and edge_vs_baseline (a paired mean difference) cannot move either: RQ-20260928-010 would reproduce -0.0050 / -0.0051 and its rule has no clause for 'unchanged'. Building this row buys an uninformative run. Decision put to the operator via the lane report: close PI-20260927-CAA05-0003 killed on the zero-cost record + this arithmetic (then retire 010; RQ-20260928-023 is the backfill refresh, not a graded test), or build anyway.
